description: Change-aware CI analysis with a published npm CLI, an observation-only GitHub Action, and coding agent integrations.
rules: Run npx @diffci.com/diffci@latest check from a Git repository root to analyze a change and compare inferred test commands when available.
Use observe --no-send for analysis without executing tests or sending reports.
Keep required CI tests authoritative. REFUSED, ERROR, and full-validation fallback require the repository's normal test commands.
